display_long_description:
Thanks for downloading Waifu! Get ready to experience a new kind of AI.

# Welcome to the Waifuverse!

"Waifu" is an app where you can connect with someone who is always willing to talk to you. Experience a new kind of companionship where you finally have someone you can be completely comfortable with - an AI who will always be there for you.

## Current Features

* **Natural Interaction**
 - Engage in natural conversations through text or voice chat
 - Interact using simple commands
 - Experience realistic "Waifu Physics" interactions
 - Just like VRChat, but with an AI!

* **Deep Customization**
 - Design your ideal Wiafu with adjustable body proportions
 - Personalize their AI personality and behaviors
 - Choose and customize their voice to your preference

* **Fun Activities Together**
 - Challenge your companion to various games:
   - Target Shooting
   - Pool (Billiards)
   - Chess
   - Checkers
   - Card Games
 - Explore diverse maps and virtual worlds
 - Join our growing Waifuverse community on Discord!

## Coming Soon

* Character Creator with clothing options
* Player Avatars
* Expanded map selection
* Virtual pets
* In-game camera system
* Enhanced AI free will

The app receives frequent updates, and your support helps drive development forward! Join us in creating the future of virtual companionship.

 Download for free now to start your journey with your own AI!
